properties.name: Feature: Spellbook (Prepared Spells Only)
properties.author: Matt Dahse
properties.description: Prepared casters choose spells from a spellbook window built from every loaded module; only the prepared spells go on the Actions tab. Right-click a spell class on the Actions tab and pick Spellbook.

announcement.text: Spellbook v1.0.3: right-click a prepared spell class on the Actions tab and choose Spellbook to pick the day's spells.
